activity.notes: Qitdlarssuaq, also known as Qillarsuaq or Qillaq, was an Inuit migration leader and shaman. He led a party from the eastern Canadian Arctic beginning in spring 1859; scholarship reconstructs the surviving migrants joining the Inughuit in northwestern Greenland around 1862, while other oral-historical reconstructions put first encounter in approximately 1863. This single representative approximate year marks contact and integration with the existing Inughuit community, not formal rule over the Inughuit, not the full 1859–1862 migration duration, and not a fabricated exact arrival day. His historically attested death around the 1870s is sufficient for deceased status but is not used as an Activity boundary.
